steps.text: Read the Terms of Service, and scroll all the way to the bottom.
Then tap Disclaimer, and scroll that to the bottom too.
After you accept, follow the next few screens until you reach Home. Then bring in a bank statement so Home fills in with your own numbers.
To change the language, tap the menu.
Pick a language from the list. Each one is shown in its own words, like Español for Spanish.
The whole app switches right away. To switch back, tap Language again and pick English.
